description.content:
The controller is responsible for handling the creation, updating, deleting and retrieval of appointment.
Mainly the controller allow to manage appointment (current and future).
Every appointment has related activity.

### Appointment id formats
####  Single appointment 
* "{Id}"  -->   "997"
####  Single appointment from recurring series ("ghost" appointment from future)
*  "{Id]-[RecurringDefinitionId}-{OriginalStartDate}"  -->   "0-5173-638186040000000000"

description.content:
Creates multiple appointments in a single request (max 20 per request). Each appointment is processed individually and the response 
includes the result for each appointment (success with created appointment or failure with error details).
Partial success is possible - some appointments may succeed while others fail.
